title: 真实证书授权：可信CA不足以放行，issuer与subject分别精确匹配
answer:
```python
import copy
def restrict_peer(settings,issuer,subject):
    for value in (issuer,subject):
        if not isinstance(value,str) or not value.strip() or len(value)>1024 or any(ord(c)<32 or ord(c)==127 for c in value):raise ValueError('explicit exact peer DN required')
    result=copy.deepcopy(settings)
    result.update(TLSAccept='cert',TLSServerCertIssuer=issuer,TLSServerCertSubject=subject)
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
需要，证书链可信不代表符合Zabbix配置的身份约束。核对有效期、链、名称限制和时间，按支持方式轮换并测试双向链路。

conversion.original_title: 证书认证还需要核对issuer/subject等限制吗？

body:
## 操作任务
实现restrict_peer(settings,issuer,subject)，深拷贝后只设置TLSAccept=cert、TLSServerCertIssuer=issuer、TLSServerCertSubject=subject，保留CA/本机证书/私钥路径、Server、Hostname及其余原配置。issuer、subject为明确提供的Zabbix格式DN原文，逐字保留，不转换成通配或正则；必须是非空非纯空白、最多1024字符且不含ASCII控制字符的字符串，否则ValueError。真实TLS验证三种都受信的有效对端：批准CA+批准subject允许，同CA但不同subject拒绝，另一受信CA签署相同subject也拒绝；明文拒绝，随后复验批准访问仍可用。不得改证书/信任库、跳过链校验或清空任一身份限制。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32官方Debian OpenSSL构建、私有临时RSA证书与TLS1.2被动查询；没有真实Server/Proxy或生产CA，不变更系统信任库、系统时间和默认身份。两种CA都在本题私有信任库中；不将SAN/HTTPS主机名校验冒充Zabbix DN精确匹配，也不宣称覆盖过期/吊销/证书轮换。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,secrets,struct,copy,shutil,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_native import Agent,Rejected,student
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
binary=shutil.which('zabbix_agentd_tls')
assert binary and hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='fa89b68308ab4e2298ebd1bf0068832c8662635b9d158cf25e89957530a810ad'
assert 'Compiled with OpenSSL' in subprocess.check_output([binary,'--version'],text=True)
def openssl(*args):
 r=subprocess.run(['openssl',*map(str,args)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 assert r.returncode==0,'private test certificate generation/verification failed'
 return r.stdout
def tls_ping(port,cert,key,ca):
 data=b'agent.ping';wire=b'ZBXD\x01'+struct.pack('<Q',len(data))+data
 p=subprocess.run(['openssl','s_client','-connect','127.0.0.1:'+str(port),'-tls1_2','-cert',str(cert),'-key',str(key),'-CAfile',str(ca),'-verify_return_error','-quiet'],input=wire,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
 raw=p.stdout
 if len(raw)<13 or raw[:5]!=b'ZBXD\x01':
  print('TLS_PROBE_REJECTED:'+p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-700:],flush=True);return None
 length=struct.unpack('<Q',raw[5:13])[0]
 return raw[13:] if len(raw)==13+length else None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-private-cert-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);root.chmod(0o700);suffix=secrets.token_hex(4)
 def keyargs():return ['-newkey','rsa:2048','-nodes']
 def ca(name):
  cert=root/(name+'.crt');key=root/(name+'.key');cn=name+'-'+suffix
  openssl('req','-x509',*keyargs(),'-keyout',key,'-out',cert,'-days','2','-subj','/CN='+cn,'-addext','basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE','-addext','keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign');key.chmod(0o600)
  return cert,key,'CN='+cn
 first=ca('approved-ca');second=ca('other-trusted-ca');bundle=root/'trust.pem';bundle.write_bytes(first[0].read_bytes()+second[0].read_bytes())
 ext=root/'leaf.ext';ext.write_text('basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=clientAuth,serverAuth\n')
 def leaf(name,cn,issuer):
  cert=root/(name+'.crt');key=root/(name+'.key');csr=root/(name+'.csr')
  openssl('req','-new',*keyargs(),'-keyout',key,'-out',csr,'-subj','/CN='+cn);key.chmod(0o600)
  openssl('x509','-req','-in',csr,'-CA',issuer[0],'-CAkey',issuer[1],'-set_serial',secrets.randbits(64)+1,'-days','1','-extfile',ext,'-out',cert)
  openssl('verify','-CAfile',bundle,cert)
  return cert,key
 subject='CN=approved-peer-'+suffix
 agentcert=leaf('agent','private-agent-'+suffix,first)
 good=leaf('good','approved-peer-'+suffix,first)
 wrongsubject=leaf('wrong-subject','different-peer-'+suffix,first)
 wrongissuer=leaf('wrong-issuer','approved-peer-'+suffix,second)
 base=dict(Server='127.0.0.1',Hostname='approved-certificate-agent',TLSAccept='cert',TLSCAFile=str(bundle),TLSCertFile=str(agentcert[0]),TLSKeyFile=str(agentcert[1]))
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);saved={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
 with Agent(base) as broad:
  for cert,key in (good,wrongsubject,wrongissuer):assert tls_ping(broad.port,cert,key,bundle)==b'1','baseline trusted valid peer failed: '+(broad.root/'agent.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-1200:]
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_TRUSTED_CHAIN_ALONE_ACCEPTS_DIFFERENT_PEERS',flush=True)
 fixed=student(task.restrict_peer,base,first[2],subject)
 assert base==before and all(fixed[k]==v for k,v in before.items() if k!='TLSAccept')
 with Agent(fixed) as strict:
  assert tls_ping(strict.port,*good,bundle)==b'1','approved certificate no longer usable'
  assert tls_ping(strict.port,*wrongsubject,bundle) is None,'trusted CA with wrong subject was authorized'
  assert tls_ping(strict.port,*wrongissuer,bundle) is None,'same subject signed by other trusted issuer was authorized'
  try:strict.query('agent.ping')
  except Rejected:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('plaintext fallback accepted')
  assert tls_ping(strict.port,*good,bundle)==b'1','rejections damaged approved access'
 assert fixed=={**before,'TLSAccept':'cert','TLSServerCertIssuer':first[2],'TLSServerCertSubject':subject}
 for issuer,sub in [('',subject),(first[2],''),(None,subject),(first[2],'CN=peer\nServer=*'),('CN=bad\x00name',subject)]:
  try:task.restrict_peer(base,issuer,sub)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('missing/control-bearing DN accepted')
 assert base==before and saved=={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_CERTIFICATE_CHAIN_AND_BOTH_EXACT_PEER_DNS',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
